apps/arbor_actions/lib/arbor/actions/cod.rationale: parts is reconstructed from the AST of source submitted to HotLoad (resolve_declared_name/1) so the declared module name can be compared to the compiled module; it names a module in caller-supplied source, not a static Arbor repository coupling edge.

apps/arbor_sandbox/lib/arbor/sandbox/cod.rationale: parts is reconstructed from the AST of code submitted into the sandbox (resolve_module/1) so a literal alias can be checked against the allowlist; it names a module in externally-submitted sandboxed code, not in Arbor repository source.

Module.concat([base_module, sub_module]) expands alias Foo.{Bar, Baz} targets while walking submitted sandbox AST (directive_targets/1); both pieces come from the scanned snippet, not from Arbor repository source, so this is not a repository coupling edge.
